description: Co-operative Employees Pension Schema - Amended and Approved Cooperative Employees Pension Scheme Statute and Provincial Council of North western Province.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of regulations (Co-operative Employees' Pension Scheme Regulations) under statutory authority. It contains detailed legal modifications to existing regulations, including changes to contribution percentages, payment timelines, surcharges, and administrative procedures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
